axial_qualification.domain_guard_derivation: ||E_K||_op >= 1 means K_eff + Delta K need not stay positive definite, so the linearisation whose remainder is being bounded is undefined; this is a domain condition, not a tolerance
axial_qualification.remainder_invariance: the spectrum of E_K is the generalised eigenvalues of (Delta K, K_eff), so the classification is invariant under congruence and under an overall rescaling
axial_qualification.remainder_normalisation: E_K = K_eff^{-1/2} Delta K K_eff^{-1/2}; identically the normalised thermal-Hessian residual because H_eff and K_eff differ by the scalar k_B T

remainder_propagation.centre: a relative enlargement of ||E_K||_op / 2 on the centre statistic
remainder_propagation.contrast_bias: the two records' magnitudes, into the existing contrast bias
remainder_propagation.geometry_bias: ||E_K - (tr E_K / d) I||_op, into the existing T4 shape budget
remainder_propagation.log_beta_bias: |tr(E_K)| / d, into the existing per-record absolute bounded bias
remainder_propagation.new_budget: NONE; the remainder has no allowance of its own

axial_qualification.remainder_type: NonlinearRemainder: a symmetric 2x2 STIFFNESS residual in N/m, typed and unit-declared; a raw float is refused
axial_qualification.removed: the V3 constant 1e-3 was compared against a DIMENSIONAL N/m quantity and is removed as a release predicate

calibration_covariance.bounded_bias: separate structure; never converted into covariance; a missing bound is MISSING, not 0.0
calibration_covariance.conditional_plus_calibration: Var_total = Var_cond + Var_cal, summed once in e1a_v5.calibration.combined_standard_error; the two sources share no primitive, so the declared model carries no cross term
calibration_covariance.contrasts: C_d = D C_b D^T, read off the SAME joint matrix; no independent recomputation
calibration_covariance.differencing_step: each primitive is stepped by its OWN declared standard uncertainty, so the step carries that primitive's units
calibration_covariance.equivalence_demonstration: option B (central differences of the fully profiled pseudo-true parameter) agrees with option A at every entry within both methods' certified enclosures
calibration_covariance.expected_likelihood: closed form via a discrete Lyapunov solve, including the innovation MEAN term so the centre nuisance is identified; no trajectory generated
calibration_covariance.forbidden_shortcut: the ideal Gaussian trace formula is NOT used as the production sensitivity
calibration_covariance.joint_matrix: C_b,cal = J_beta C_phi J_beta^T over all eight log-beta endpoints
calibration_covariance.log_beta_extraction: one row, taken only AFTER the full nuisance system is solved
calibration_covariance.perturbation_side: phi moves the ANALYSIS side (H_A and the observation calibration) with the truth held fixed, which is what a calibration measurement error physically is; V3 perturbed the truth instead and so reported the opposite sign
calibration_covariance.sensitivity_method: U.20 option A: implicit differentiation of the expected-score system, d theta*/d phi = -(d_theta E s)^{-1} d_phi E s
calibration_covariance.shared_primitive_rule: one variable identity per shared standard; off-diagonal blocks follow with no independence assumption

numerical_error_certification.evaluation_noise: MEASURED per record by least-squares fitting the exact low-order polynomial the smooth objective must follow over a 1e-6 window and taking the largest residual
numerical_error_certification.fixed_band_removed: the V3 CALIBRATION_NUMERICAL_RTOL = 1e-5 and the fixed-band classifier are deleted
numerical_error_certification.method: certified componentwise enclosure of the Jacobian, from (a) the full fine/coarse step-consistency gap, which for an h^2 scheme is three times the Richardson estimate and so conservative, and (b) the measured evaluation noise of the expected log likelihood propagated through the linear solve as ||H^{-1}|| (eps/(h g) + eps/h^2 |J|)
numerical_error_certification.propagation_to_sigma: x -> sqrt(x^T C x) is a seminorm, so |sigma(j+d) - sigma(j)| <= sigma(d), and the supremum over the box |d_k| <= radius_k is bounded by sqrt(radius^T |C_phi| radius) entrywise
numerical_error_certification.qualification_rule: PASS iff u_+ <= c; FAIL iff u_- > c; UNRESOLVED otherwise, with T/U inclusive ceiling semantics and c never widened
